summary: Arbitration clause applicability to deed cancellation suit; Specific Relief Act Section 31 action not in rem per Deccan Paper Mills precedent; Trial Court referral to arbitration justified under Arbitration Act Section 8; High Court error in treating cancellation dispute as non-arbitrable; appeal allowed, High Court judgment set aside, arbitration referral restored.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order VII Rule 11
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court order under Section 8 of Arbitration Act restored; parties directed to refer dispute to arbitration.
